title: fix(agents): preserve configured fallback for visible children
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Visible children created without a model choice failed after a primary rate limit instead of using their configured backup. Closes #148886.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared spawn planner records automatic intent; creation stores the validated provider and model. Chat and direct `agent` requests carry the stored child relationship to `resolveModelFallbackAvailability`, which owns the backup list. Initial provenance has one writer: session creation.

## User Impact

Children without an explicit model choice use their configured backups during initial and later direct requests. Explicit choices and empty backup lists remain strict; profile suffixes are preserved.

## Evidence

On main, real `chat.send` → `sessions_spawn` children stored user provenance, made ten primary HTTP 429 requests, and failed without a backup request.

The new direct-request cases also reproduced a remaining defect on prior head `1f075e91b09a94c85346baf2fa55ccf63177f000`: later `agent` requests used the agent backup despite distinct or empty child lists.

All eleven Gateway cases passed again using the frozen merge source committed unchanged as `647e2a8ee0cc0087d8a2e90b0e45708c445c66f5` (tree `458047fbe0e057646a3fc73344a9505a5755554a`). This includes current main `14b8ad1d187104ac0ba4bc13afa364997aa4bc39`. The selection owner files and test inputs are unchanged, but their runtime dependencies changed; all eleven cases were rerun and no earlier passing runtime result was reused.

`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/server.visible-spawn-fallback.product-proof.test.ts`

Seven owner and sibling files plus four files that failed in the previous CI run passed on the same source: 716 tests passed, one existing test skipped. The four failing files also passed on the previous CI merge, its main parent, and the parents of the relevant earlier changes. Their hosted timing and cleanup failures were not reproduced locally. The main merge includes the handoff fixture line-limit repair from #149427; lint, formatting, line limits, assertion checks, unused exports, and type checks pass.

`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/agents/{agent-scope,agent-command.live-model-switch,model-fallback}.test.ts src/agents/tools/sessions-spawn-tool.test.ts src/agents/subagents/spawn/subagent-spawn.model-session.test.ts src/gateway/{server.sessions.create,agent-runtime-identity-token}.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/execute.executable-invocation.test.ts src/agents/sessions/bash-executor.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/{chat-history-omission-request,sessions.send-yield-resume}.test.ts`

## Compatibility

No public request or durable schema changes. The direct-request correction adds no configuration or protocol fields. Cross-runtime transitions remain untested.

## Consumers

Visible child creation, chat execution, direct agent execution, and fallback diagnostics share the recorded facts.

## Invalidation

Each turn resolves current configuration. Direct execution reads depth from its current session snapshot; existing selection and reset cleanup owns stored overrides.

## Tests

The shared fixture checks actual HTTP choices, terminal results, and child history. Direct-request cases first complete a primary-only child turn, then isolate the later request and history so initial success cannot satisfy follow-up checks. Distinct child lists, empty lists, and explicit per-run selection are covered.

The retired fixture also restricted the generated key suffix to letters, digits, and hyphens. Its replacement checks the session prefix and resolves the returned key through listing, storage, and history. Key generation is unchanged and belongs to session creation.

Growth accepted under the owner's standing acceptance (2026-09-15).
